summary: Cadeler plc filed a 6-K reporting completion of its share-exchange offer for Cadeler A/S, part of a redomiciliation from Denmark to the UK (the US-equivalent mechanics being a stock-for-stock exchange offer). Each A/S share, including those represented by ADSs, exchanged for one Cadeler share, with roughly 7.94% untendered, lifting tendering holders' relative stake by 8.62%. Cadeler holds over 90%, enabling a Danish-law compulsory squeeze-out at NOK 58.42 per share cash, based on the 30-day OSE VWAP. Cadeler shares begin trading 5 November 2026 on NYSE and OSE under CDLR; A/S ADSs face suspension and delisting. A DNB Bank ASA facility funds the squeeze-out. Watch the notice expected 9 November 2026, the four-week acceptance window, delisting timing and residual holder risk.
